summary: Master GHG Protocol and corporate carbon accounting with practical tools, boundary methods, and reporting templates for credible emissions inventories.
lede: GHG Protocol training helps sustainability, finance, operations, and environmental reporting professionals build corporate emissions inventories. Participants learn to set organizational and operational boundaries, map emission sources, calculate Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions, and screen relevant Scope 3 categories. The course also covers data quality checks, base year recalculation, internal controls, and preparing a reporting pack for management review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already touch sustainability, finance, operations, or environmental reporting and now need to build a more defensible carbon inventory. It suits people working across reporting, control, analysis, procurement, and assurance roles who need practical carbon accounting skills rather than introductory climate awareness.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop with spreadsheet software installed and be ready to work with sample emissions data or your own anonymized activity data if available. A basic understanding of corporate emissions concepts is recommended, and pre-reading on the GHG Protocol Corporate Standard will help you move faster during the boundary and calculation exercises.
